name: Official-source traceability
requirement: 100% of published rows carry an https:// link to a page read on the verification date
blocks_failure_mode: unsourced numbers, third-party recitation, hallucinated values
measured: 32 clubs, 137 games accounted for in the registers
unlock: none - keep the rule in CI

name: Blank-not-guessed rule
requirement: Any field with no official confirmation is the empty string, never a proxy value
measured: every blank cell renders as an empty td
unlock: none - keep the rule in CI

name: Licensed market-data feed
requirement: >=1 licensed quote source with opening/close history and book identifiers
blocks_failure_mode: comparing our lines to nothing, or to a scraped number we may not use
measured: 0 licensed feeds configured in this repository - no vendor contract file, no quote archive, no stored credential; the only market-shaped numbers on disk are another pack's own model output, which is not a price
unlock: contract Genius Sports or a licensed odds vendor; archive the signed scope as JSON

name: Point-in-time integrity
requirement: >=2 archived, hash-stamped snapshots per slate (pre-inactive and post-inactive)
blocks_failure_mode: using Friday designations to explain a line quoted Thursday
unlock: run the weekly four-anchor snapshot job for 4 weeks before any CLV claim

name: Sample size
requirement: >=200 settled selections and >=30 distinct slates per strategy
blocks_failure_mode: a 12-game hot streak read as an edge
unlock: start logging model lines before kickoff; 200 selections is roughly two full seasons of one strategy

name: Chronological out-of-sample holdout
requirement: fit window strictly before test window; >=25% of slates held out; no refit on test data
blocks_failure_mode: in-sample fit presented as forward accuracy
measured: no fit window exists yet (ratings are season-to-date only)
unlock: becomes computable once >=8 slates of archived lines and results exist

name: Same-line closing-line value
requirement: t >= 2.5 on de-vigged (our prob - close prob), same line, no line-move substitution
blocks_failure_mode: beating a stale number instead of the closing market

name: Proper-score calibration
requirement: Brier and log-loss vs de-vigged close; reliability slope inside [0.90, 1.10]
blocks_failure_mode: a profitable-looking model that is simply over-confident
measured: model probabilities published; no market probabilities to compare against
unlock: needs the DG-03 quote archive on disk (opening and closing price, book id and timestamp per game); calibration is then a Brier comparison against de-vigged market probability over at least 200 settled games

name: Multiple-comparison control
requirement: Holm-Bonferroni across the frozen candidate family (M published before any test)
blocks_failure_mode: 12 tries at 5% producing one 'significant' strategy by arithmetic
measured: family frozen at M=12 before any outcome was scored
unlock: not applicable while the family stays frozen; re-freeze by pull request if it changes

name: Dependence handling in combos
requirement: no parlay or prop-combo price may assume independence; use joint residuals or Frechet bounds
blocks_failure_mode: multiplying marginal probabilities and calling the product a price
measured: bounds published for every combo family; independence used only as the null, never as the price
unlock: not applicable - this gate is passing

name: Key-number and push arithmetic
requirement: settlement probability must include push mass and .5 alternatives; no continuous normal shortcut
blocks_failure_mode: systematic mispricing around 3 and 7 in the NFL
measured: discrete Poisson convolution; push probability published per game
unlock: not applicable - this gate is passing

name: Assumption robustness
requirement: the favoured side must not flip sign across the published assumption grid
blocks_failure_mode: a 'signal' that is really a hidden dial in the model
measured: favoured side stable on 84.6% of the published slate
unlock: tighten the grid if any game flips

name: Cost and vig awareness
requirement: edge must clear the break-even win rate at the quoted price (11/21 = 52.38% at -110)
blocks_failure_mode: winning at 51% and calling it profit
measured: no quotes on file to attach a price to
unlock: needs the same DG-03 archive - vig is the gap between the two sides' implied probabilities, which cannot be measured from a source this repository does not hold

name: Reproducibility
requirement: builder --check byte-equality and seeded recompute of every derived number
blocks_failure_mode: tables that no longer match the code that produced them
measured: checker recomputes league facts, lines, gates and correlations

name: Stability and decay
requirement: rolling 4-slate selection rate and hit rate inside the global CI; no cliff after a rule change
blocks_failure_mode: an edge that existed only before the league changed a rule
measured: needs >=8 slates of archived model output

name: Cross-season persistence check
requirement: report the measured year-to-year correlation of the rating input before trusting it as a prior
blocks_failure_mode: assuming last season's scoring differentials are still this season's information
